data.narrative:
Nucleus Genomics is a Series A biotech company founded by Kian Sadeghi that has raised $32M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals, though narrow-filter peer matching proved insufficient for direct median benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis was the applicable triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($32M) as a value proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $64M. This reflects the incremental value creation and risk reduction expected between Series A close and next financing.

Public-comp anchoring could not be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure—standard for private companies. The Biotech & Health public peer set trades at a 6.6x price-to-sales median, but lacks revenue visibility on Nucleus to scale multiples meaningfully.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $54M (low) to $74M (high), centered at $64M (median). Key uncertainties include the lack of narrow-set private peer comparables at identical stage and tier, absence of revenue or clinical data to calibrate against public multiples, and limited visibility into capital efficiency or technical differentiation. A subsequent financing round will provide material new pricing signals.
